sentences.en: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
sentences.zh: 如果爆发核战争，全人类都将遭受苦难。

sentences.en: We are suffering from a severe water shortage this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天我们正遭受严重的水资源短缺之苦。

sentences.en: That is why so many people are suffering from famine.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么如此多的人正在挨饿受苦。

senses.zh: 受损害；受痛苦；遭受，忍受；经验
